Components / Message

Question

The agent asks, the user answers with one tap — the PRD's touch verdict, where a tap IS the submission and the choice persists in the transcript afterward. The web original's select-then-submit and free-text modes are dropped with it.

  • v0.2.1
  • component
  • nativewind
  • uniwind
  • runs in Expo Go

Install

npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/nativewind/question.json
npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/uniwind/question.json

Dependencies

No required npm packages — this item installs through the registry dependencies below.

Source

Props

NameTypeDefaultDescription
valuestring | null | undefined—Controlled answer. Omit it and the card owns its selection.
onOptionSelect((value: string) => void) | undefined—Fires once, with the chosen option's value. Sending the message is the caller's job.
disabledboolean | undefinedfalse—
childrenReact.ReactNode——

Theming

Themed via text-muted-foreground, text-foreground.

Usage

() => ( <Question onOptionSelect={() => {}}> <QuestionPrompt>Which engine should apps/example install?</QuestionPrompt> <QuestionOptions> <QuestionOption value="uniwind">uniwind — Tailwind v4</QuestionOption> <QuestionOption value="nativewind">nativewind — Tailwind v3</QuestionOption> <QuestionOption value="both">Prove both, ship either</QuestionOption> </QuestionOptions> </Question> )
